_comment: Simulation parameters. value + verify + source. Anything verify:true is an assumption listed in the report.

downrank_penalty_model.source: Players report Shadow Bolt r1 at level 55 hits for ~250 (little or no penalty). Classic: spells below level 20 get coefficient x (1-(20-spellLevel)*0.0375). 'partial' = midpoint.

bane_per_rank.source: CONFIRMED by guildorder.com, allthings.how and timesaver.gg tooltips: Bane takes 0.1 s per rank off Shadow Bolt/Immolate/Incinerate (0.5 s at 5/5); consistent with the players' 1.2 s Shadow Bolt rank 1 at 5/5.

haste_shortens_gcd.source: CONFIRMED by the user (26 Nov 2026): in WoW Forever haste always shortens the GCD. No effect while haste_pct is 0 (the default).

min_gcd_ms.source: Assumed floor when haste shortens the GCD.

haste_pct.source: Spell haste percent; 0 in all default profiles.

shadow_spell_power_bonus.source: Extra spell power for Shadow spells; 0 by default, 21 with the Major Spellstone option (the stone text says 'up to 21').

cast_floor_ms.source: Assumed minimum cast time after Bane.

skip_agony_if_ttk_below.source: Seconds. Bane of Agony and Curse of the Elements are skipped when the estimated time to kill the target is below it. 0 = never skip.

use_curse_of_elements.source: Affliction and Demonology rotation: Curse of the Elements is cast first when the target has no curse (the user's rotation, 26 Nov 2026; it is per target, so it is cast on every mob). In the simulator it costs 0.3-4 kills per hour (a GCD and mana for +4% damage in a fight of about 20 s), so it is a choice of the user, not of the optimiser. Subject to skip_agony_if_ttk_below. Earlier results (before 26 Nov) were computed without it.

demo_use_agony.source: Demonology rotation uses Bane of Agony (optional in the task).

rest_to_mana_pct.source: Session start and after a death: full mana. A break drinks only while eating (minimal drinking).

rest_to_hp_pct.source: A food and water break lasts until HP is full.

eat_and_drink_together.source: Classic allows eating and drinking at once: downtime = max(eat, drink).

transition_sec.source: Time to find and reach the next mob, added to every cycle.

death_penalty_sec.source: Corpse run and resurrection after the player dies.

pet_resummon_sec.source: Re-summon time after the pet died.

pull_time_limit_sec.source: Safety limit for one pull (out of mana and no Life Tap).

mob_miss_pct.source: CONFLICT: Method.gg says 4% hit is needed to never miss a same-level mob (4% miss); Warcraft Tavern says 3% miss; whether a 1% minimum miss exists is unknown. No Blizzard number found.

pushback_ms.source: Cast end delay per mob hit while casting.

life_tap_spirit_coeff.source: warcraft.wiki.gg Forever: 'Spirit increases the amount converted' (no number). A guide (warcrafttavern summary) gives cost = base + Spirit: coefficient 1.0 assumed.

searing_pain_threat_mult.source: Searing Pain generates extra threat; Demonic Brand halves it (task statement: 50% less aggro).

threat_overtake_ranged.source: Threat needed to pull aggro from a melee holder when the overtaker is ranged.

threat_overtake_melee.source: Threat needed for a melee overtaker.

pet_opens.source: The pet engages first and holds initial aggro.

brand_scale.source: Brand damage (60-26)*1.5 + 14..17 + 0.078*SP at 3/3: whether '60' is the caster level.

brand_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on Demonic Brand damage.

wrack_dmg_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on Wrack tick damage (the formula itself is confirmed, see spells.json).

mob_hp_mult.source: Forever raised the health of higher-level creatures before launch by an unknown factor (Blizzard dev notes, 3 Nov 2026); Wowhead Forever shows Classic-equal health for the mobs it lists. 1.0 = Classic health. Sensitivity axis.

sb_r1_coeff_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on the spell power coefficient of Shadow Bolt rank 1 (castTime/3.5).

sb_r2_coeff_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on the spell power coefficient of Shadow Bolt rank 2.

fsr_regen_fraction.source: Share of Spirit regen that continues while casting (Classic: 0). Soul Harvest lifts it to 100%.

sb_filler_lifetap_when_oom.source: Emergency Life Tap when nothing is affordable (down to lt_safety_hp_pct of HP, ignoring the usual HP rules); without it the warlock would idle.

pet_hit_chance.source: Pet melee/spell hit chance vs same-level mob (estimate).

pet_initial_threat_per_level.source: Threat head start of the pet when it opens the pull.

corruption_min_ttk_sec.source: Rotation rule: Corruption/Siphon Life/Immolate only when the estimated TTK is at least this.

wrack_min_hp_pct.source: Affliction rotation option (26 Nov 2026): Wrack is channelled only while the player's health is above this fraction; below it Drain Life is the filler (heals, so Life Tap can keep paying for the casts). 0 = always Wrack (the earlier behaviour).

fire_filler.source: DEMO_FIRE filler; compare Searing Pain with Shadow Bolt rank 1 (task).

session_pulls.source: Pulls per simulated session (mana and HP carry over between pulls).

drain_dmg_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on Drain Life and Drain Soul damage (their coefficients and totals are estimates; Drain Life is strong in the model).

pet_dmg_mult.source: Sensitivity multiplier on all pet damage (pet damage tables are estimates).

agony_ramp.source: Wiki: Bane of Agony 'is dealt slowly at first, and builds up'. The 0.5x/1.0x/1.5x thirds pattern (4 ticks each) is the Classic one; the Forever shape is NOT confirmed.

life_tap_mana_per_health.source: warcraft.wiki.gg Forever: 'Converts 30 Health into 30 Mana' (1.0). A guide's summary says 1.2 mana per health: unconfirmed.

drain_soul_window_sec.source: Rotation rule (task: 'Drain Soul na dobicie'): use Drain Soul when the estimated time to kill is at most this many seconds, so the kill lands inside the channel (Soul Harvest).

use_drain_soul_finisher.source: Rotation option (task: 'Drain Soul na dobicie' for Soul Harvest). Tested on/off in the sensitivity analysis because Drain Soul itself deals little damage.

lt_combat_mana_pct.source: User's rule (25 Nov 2026). Life Tap when mana is below this fraction and HP is above lt_combat_hp_pct.

lt_low_mana_pct.source: User's rule (25 Nov 2026). Life Tap when mana is below this fraction and HP is above lt_low_hp_pct.

lt_between_mana_pct.source: User's rule (25 Nov 2026). Between mobs, with HP at 100%, Life Tap when mana is below this fraction (the warlock should not keep HP full).

pet_ooc_regen_pct_per_sec.source: Share of its maximum health the demon regains per second out of combat. Not found for Forever. Classic estimate: the cmangos emulator regenerates a player-controlled creature 13% of its health every 5 s (src/game/Entities/Creature.cpp, RegenerateHealth and REGEN_TIME_FULL_UNIT, read 27 Nov 2026).

pet_ooc_mana_per_sec.source: Mana the demon regains per second out of combat. Not found for Forever. Stand-in: the in-combat rate the model already uses for a pet that is not an Imp (fight.ts, 0.5 per second). Imps have no mana regeneration in the model.

pet_funnel_below_pct.source: Health Funnel is channelled between pulls when the demon's health is below this fraction (0 = never). A choice of the player. Sweep 27 Nov 2026 (150 sessions, carried-over health and mana): 0.7 is the best tried or within about 7 kills per hour of it in the cells measured (levels 22-50, 1 and 2 mobs). 0.4 and lower let the demon die often with 2 mobs (Demonology at level 40: 17 deaths per hour, 53 kills per hour against 110 at 0.7); 0.5 costs Demonology up to 49 kills per hour at level 50 with 2 mobs. Exception: single-mob Wrack builds at 22 do better never funnelling (the demon dies about 30 times per hour there; the model's resummon cost is small).

pet_funnel_to_pct.source: The channel stops when the demon's health reaches this fraction (or after its 10 s, or at lt_safety_hp_pct of your health).

break_hp_pct.source: User's rule (25 Nov 2026). Below this HP fraction the warlock stops for food and water (the only reason to stop).

lt_safety_hp_pct.source: Safety: a Life Tap is never cast if it would leave less than this HP fraction.

lt_between_hp_pct.source: User's rule: between mobs Life Tap needs HP at 100% (default 0.995); lower values let the warlock tap between mobs at lower HP. Life Tap policy parameter.

break_mana_pct.source: Optional break trigger: stop for food and water also when mana falls below this fraction (0 = never; the user's rule has none).

drink_to_mana_pct.source: 0 = drink only while eating (user's rule); above 0 = keep drinking after the meal until this mana fraction.

fsr_sec.source: Five-second rule: Spirit mana regeneration resumes this many seconds after the last mana-spending cast (Classic rule; Forever keeps a 'while casting' mechanic for talents such as Soul Harvest, so a rule exists). Applied to the walk between mobs.

drink_adds_spirit_regen.source: Whether the Spirit regeneration adds to a drink's tooltip rate is unknown (Forever drink tooltips were fixed to show total mana regeneration on 16 Oct). False = only the tooltip rate.

eureka_policy.source: When the gnome uses Eureka!. off = never (default, so earlier results stay the same); pull_start = with the first cast of the pull; first_affected = with the first affected spell; filler = when the filler starts (after the DoTs); delay = first affected spell at or after eureka_delay_sec; ttk = when the estimated time to kill drops under the buff duration. Wowhead Forever spell 1259821 (Eureka!, gnome racial, level 1): instant, off the global cooldown, 2 min cooldown, 8 s. Effect 1: -10% mana cost; effect 2: +10% damage of non-periodic abilities; effect 3: +10% periodic damage of Drain Life, Drain Soul, Wrack and Haunt only. Affected spells (Wowhead 'Modifies' list, 89 rows): Immolate, Shadow Bolt, Drain Life, Drain Soul, Hellfire, Searing Pain, Rain of Fire, Soul Fire, Death Coil, Conflagrate, Shadowburn, Wrack, Haunt. NOT affected: Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life, Life Tap, curses, and the damage over time of Immolate.

eureka_delay_sec.source: Seconds into the pull for the 'delay' policy.

eureka_mod.source: Wowhead Forever spell 1259821 (Eureka!, gnome racial, level 1): instant, off the global cooldown, 2 min cooldown, 8 s. Effect 1: -10% mana cost; effect 2: +10% damage of non-periodic abilities; effect 3: +10% periodic damage of Drain Life, Drain Soul, Wrack and Haunt only. Affected spells (Wowhead 'Modifies' list, 89 rows): Immolate, Shadow Bolt, Drain Life, Drain Soul, Hellfire, Searing Pain, Rain of Fire, Soul Fire, Death Coil, Conflagrate, Shadowburn, Wrack, Haunt. NOT affected: Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life, Life Tap, curses, and the damage over time of Immolate. Assumption: periodic damage is re-evaluated on every tick of a channel (a tick inside the 8 s gets the bonus); the buff is checked when a cast completes (direct damage) or starts (mana cost).
